purpose: Locate 2010 excerpt in the public NARA recordings; test a claimed source relationship, not historical words or wall-clock time.
comparison_sources: NARA 7598764 DCC-1923 position 28; same source claimed by 2010 article
NARA 7598789 DCC-1935 position 4; separate channel named by 2004 staff note
method: ffmpeg decode mono s16le 1000 Hz, highpass 80Hz and lowpass 400Hz; search normalized Pearson waveform correlation over whole recordings
decision: At least three non-overlapping windows must exceed 0.25 and have source-offset minus clip-offset values within 0.2 s; report signed coefficients and full maxima.
negative_control: reverse 10-second-start waveform and search each recording under the same method
limitations: No automatic recognition or content interpretation
No inference of date, clock, historical call origin or intent
No-match is not evidence of absence; different mixing, edits, speed, noise or telephone channel can prevent matching
A match is evidence of shared audio signal, not independent verification of reported events
